english.title: Manufacturer of electrical equipment fail to retain technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of electrical equipment namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), failed to keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity drawn up in respect of the equipment and make them available for inspection by the market surveillance authority for a period of ten years beginning on the day on which the equipment was placed on the market, namely **(..SPECIFY DATE WHEN PLACED ON THE MARKET..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7, 50(1) and 51(2) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
